title: Burnham refuses to rule out tax rises in autumn Budget
summary: UK Budget officials may face constraints that could necessitate tax increases in the upcoming autumn Budget. Experts suggest limited flexibility for Chancellor John Healey and Burnham in their initial Budget planning.
content: Experts have warned that he and Chancellor John Healey will have little room to manoeuvre in their first Budget.

zh.title: 伯纳姆不排除秋季预算中增税的可能性
zh.summary: 英国预算官员可能面临可能需要在即将到来的秋季预算中增加税收的限制。专家认为财政大臣约翰·希利和伯纳姆在初步预算规划中灵活性有限。

title: Trump targets Iran’s trade lifelines — here are the countries most exposed
summary: The Trump administration's threatened economic sanctions against Iran could severely impact a handful of countries that conduct most of Iran's remaining foreign trade. These governments face significant economic exposure from potential U.S. economic pressure.
content: Washington's threat of "economic D-Day" collides with a small group of governments that account for most of what remains of Iran's foreign trade.

zh.title: 特朗普打击伊朗贸易生命线——这些国家风险最大
zh.summary: 特朗普政府威胁对伊朗实施经济制裁,可能严重影响进行伊朗大部分剩余外贸的少数几个国家。这些政府面临来自潜在美国经济压力的重大经济风险。

title: Shein targets $27 billion Hong Kong IPO — a fraction of its 2022 valuation
summary: Fast-fashion retailer Shein is seeking to raise approximately $1.77 billion through a Hong Kong IPO, marking a significant valuation decline from its 2022 peak. The planned offering represents a fraction of the company's previous market assessment.
content: Shein is planning to raise up to $13.86 billion in Hong Kong dollars ($1.77 billion) in its initial public offering, according to a filing on Monday.

zh.title: 希音目标270亿美元香港IPO——仅为2022年估值的一小部分
zh.summary: 快时尚零售商希音寻求通过香港IPO筹集约17.7亿美元,相比2022年高峰期估值大幅下降。该计划发行代表了公司之前市场评估的一部分。

title: The Gurkha families fighting for their pensions
summary: Gurkha soldiers who retired before 1997 continue to fight for pension parity with British Army veterans, receiving significantly lower benefits. The disparity remains a contentious issue for these families decades after their retirement.
content: Gurkhas who retired before 1997 receive far less than their British Army counterparts.

zh.title: 廓尔喀士兵家庭为养老金争取平等待遇
zh.summary: 1997年前退役的廓尔喀士兵继续争取与英国陆军老兵的养老金平等待遇，目前领取的福利明显较低。这一差异在他们退役数十年后仍然是这些家庭的争议问题。

title: Drought leaves 'barely any apples' to make cider
summary: A severe drought has devastated apple harvests, with some orchards producing only a tenth of their normal yield. The crisis threatens cider production and the economic viability of affected orchards.
content: Some orchards are harvesting just a 10th of their usual crop, and facing an uncertain future.

zh.title: 干旱导致"几乎没有苹果"可用于制作苹果酒
zh.summary: 严重的干旱摧毁了苹果收成，一些果园的产量仅为正常产量的十分之一。这场危机威胁到苹果酒生产和受影响果园的经济可行性。

title: Songs created by AI banned from Australia's music charts
summary: Australia's music industry has implemented a ban on AI-generated songs from official charts following a high-profile incident. The policy emerged after a DJ's AI-remixed Madonna track controversially topped the charts.
content: The move comes weeks after a DJ admitted using AI to remix a Madonna song that topped the Australian charts.

zh.title: 澳大利亚音乐排行榜禁止播放AI生成的歌曲
zh.summary: 澳大利亚音乐产业已禁止AI生成的歌曲进入官方排行榜，此举是在一个高调事件之后实施的。该政策出台是因为一名DJ的AI混音麦当娜歌曲争议性地登上了排行榜榜首。

title: Xpeng shares sink as weak delivery forecast overshadows $6.3 billion robot unit valuation
summary: Chinese electric vehicle maker Xpeng saw its stock decline following weak delivery forecasts, despite its robotics division achieving a substantial $6.3 billion valuation. The market's reaction reflects concerns about the company's core EV business despite progress in emerging robotics ventures.
content: Xpeng shares slid after weak delivery guidance, even as its nascent robotics business secured a valuation nearly matching that of its core EV business.

zh.title: 小鹏股价下跌，疲弱交付预期掩盖63亿美元机器人部门估值
zh.summary: 中国电动汽车制造商小鹏因交付预期疲弱导致股价下跌，尽管其机器人部门获得了63亿美元的可观估值。市场反应反映了对公司核心电动汽车业务的担忧，尽管新兴机器人业务取得了进展。

title: Bitcoin surges past $80,000 as crypto rally gathers pace
summary: Bitcoin has surpassed $80,000 as institutional investors continue to increase allocations through spot Bitcoin ETFs. The milestone reflects strengthening market sentiment and renewed appetite for cryptocurrency exposure.
content: Bitcoin surged past the $80,000 mark, as renewed inflows into spot bitcoin ETFs and improving risk appetite extended the cryptocurrency's recent rally.

zh.title: 比特币飙升至80000美元以上，加密货币反弹势头加强
zh.summary: 随着机构投资者继续通过现货比特币ETF增加配置，比特币已突破80000美元。这一里程碑反映了市场情绪的增强和对加密货币敞口需求的重新兴趣。

title: Porsche inks $1.5 billion deal for AI deployment with India’s largest IT services firm Tata Consultancy
summary: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) has signed a $1.5 billion contract to deploy artificial intelligence solutions for luxury automaker Porsche. The partnership reflects growing demand among manufacturers for enterprise-scale AI implementation.
content: Indian IT services giant TCS has secured a $1.5 billion contract to deploy AI for German sports carmaker Porsche.

zh.title: 保时捷与印度最大IT服务公司塔塔咨询达成15亿美元AI部署协议

title: How Canada could hit back to hurt the US economy - and Trump
summary: Canada, which exports approximately 70% of its goods to the United States, possesses limited but potentially significant economic leverage in an escalating trade dispute. The analysis examines what retaliatory measures Canada might employ to challenge U.S. trade policies.
content: What leverage does Canada, which sells about 70% of its goods to the US, actually have in this spiraling trade dispute?

zh.title: 加拿大如何反击并伤害美国经济——以及特朗普
zh.summary: 加拿大向美国出口约70%的商品，在不断升级的贸易争端中拥有有限但潜在重大的经济影响力。分析研究了加拿大可能采取的报复措施来挑战美国贸易政策。

title: Gold hits over three-month high on dollar weakness, Treasury bond buyback plans
summary: Gold prices reached a three-month high, buoyed by a weakening U.S. dollar and the Treasury Department's bond buyback initiative. The dual factors have strengthened investor demand for the precious metal as a hedge against currency depreciation.
content: Gold prices rose to its highest in over three months, supported by a weaker U.S. dollar and the U.S. treasury's recent buyback announcement

zh.title: 黄金创三个月高位，受美元走弱和财政部债券回购计划推动
zh.summary: 受美元走弱和美国财政部债券回购计划推动，黄金价格创三个月新高。这两个因素加强了投资者对贵金属作为货币贬值对冲工具的需求。

title: 70,000 social and affordable homes to be built across England as part of £39bn plan
summary: The UK government is investing £39bn to build 70,000 social and affordable homes across England, with funding allocated to regions including Greater Manchester, West Midlands, West Yorkshire, and London. This initiative aims to address the persistent shortage of affordable housing.
content: Funding has been granted to Greater Manchester, the West Midlands and West Yorkshire as well as £6bn for London.

zh.title: 英国计划投入390亿英镑建造7万套社会和经济适用房
zh.summary: 英国政府投资390亿英镑在全英格兰建造7万套社会和经济适用房，资金分配到大曼彻斯特、西米德兰兹、西约克郡和伦敦等地区。该举措旨在解决持续存在的经济适用房短缺问题。

title: US-Canada trade war escalates as Trump threatens tariff hike on autos after Carney vows to retaliate
summary: Trade tensions between the US and Canada are escalating as Trump threatens higher auto tariffs, prompting Canadian official Mark Carney to warn of retaliation and demand a change in approach. The dispute centers on tariffs that could significantly harm Canada's automotive industry.
content: Mark Carney accused Trump of wanting to "destroy" Canada's auto industry, and said he would only resume trade talks if the US comes with the "right attitude".

zh.title: 美加贸易战升级，特朗普威胁提高汽车关税，卡尼誓言报复

title: ‘She looked into COBRA’: My friend was laid off and lost her health insurance. How can she find affordable coverage?

title: Stock futures are flat as investors await Nvidia earnings, inflation report due later this week: Live updates
summary: Market sentiment remains cautious as investors await two major events this week: Nvidia's earnings report and an inflation report, both of which could significantly influence market direction and trading activity.
content: Investors turned cautious ahead of Nvidia's earnings and a closely watched inflation report. Both are due later this week.

title: Paramount CEO David Ellison is at the final hurdle before buying WBD. So far, he can't clear it

title: My father-in-law passed away, leaving a house with tenants. Do I evict them?
summary: A property inheritor who acquired a rental house with existing tenants faces uncertainty about next steps, as the rental arrangement details—whether signed leases or month-to-month agreements—remain unclear and will affect any eviction decision.
content: “We don’t know whether they have signed leases or are renting month to month.”

zh.title: 公公去世留下有租户的房子，我应该驱逐他们吗？
zh.summary: 继承了有现有租户的出租房产的业主对后续步骤感到困惑，因为租赁安排的细节（是否为签署的租约或月租协议）仍不清楚，这将影响任何驱逐决定。
